title: The SCARE 2023 guideline: updating consensus Surgical CAse REport (SCARE) guidelines.

majorUnsupportedClaims: Invents an entire limitations paragraph (Delphi panel selection bias, arbitrary consensus threshold, lack of inter-rater reliability, confidentiality preventing verification, limited external validity) that is absent from the original article.
minorUnsupportedClaims: States that seven non‑consensus items were 'excluded or modified accordingly,' but the source does not describe their disposition.
model.rationale: The generated text faithfully reproduces most study details, but it adds a fabricated limitations section discussing selection bias, consensus‑threshold arbitrariness, and missing reliability metrics – none of which appear in the original publication. This misrepresentation constitutes a major unsupported claim, and with an additional minor extrapolation (the fate of non‑consensus items), the overall fidelity is compromised.
